hooks.command: bash -c 'for d in "$PWD" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/hooks/pre-tool-use.sh" ] && exec "$d/scripts/hooks/pre-tool-use.sh"; done; exit 0'

SessionStart.command: bash -c 'for d in "$PWD" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/hooks/session-start.sh" ] && exec "$d/scripts/hooks/session-start.sh"; done; exit 0'
